description: UGA — strong GA in-state applicant, RD (SAME state as GA Tech, but mid-selectivity → DAMPED boost)
rationale: The intra-state heterogeneity sentinel. UGA (overall ~38%) is in the SAME state as Georgia Tech, yet a flat per-state 2.36× would clamp UGA in-state to ~0.95 — far above reality. residencySelectivityWeight at 38% overall ≈ 0.43 damps the GA flagship ratio to ~1.58×; with this strong profile's stat boost (~1.4×) the full-engine result is ~0.84 (anchor 0.38 × geo 1.58 × stats 1.4). Guardrail [0.73, 0.92] is a two-sided trap on the GEO behavior: revert to flat 2.36 → clamps to ~0.95 (caught above) ; revert to neutral 1.0 → ~0.53 (caught below). UGA's own OOS 31% < overall 38% confirms residency IS priced here (per-school guard does not neutralize).
